theatres.fullReview: Jang Taeyoung is an instinctive moneymaker with uncanny luck and charm. Alongside his best friend, Park Taeyoung, a brilliant strategist, he builds a thriving poker business until Park's jealousy turns into betrayal, leaving Jang with nothing. Rising from the depths, Jang returns to a high-stakes global gambling arena. Waiting for him is Park, now at the top of a vast international operation. Entangled with a Yakuza-backed executive, the two Taeyoung's rivalry escalates into an inevitable endgame, where every hand could cost everything.
